tasks.short: Coordinate and supervise packing and shipping workers.

steps.what: Review packing progress, shipment cutoffs and recorded exceptions in the warehouse system
Decide safe work priorities and assignments considering actual worker and cargo needs
Prepare and check the complete written packing and shipping assignments
Commit the approved assignments to the internal warehouse work queue
Brief workers and clarify handling instructions and responsibilities
Supervise packing and shipping, resolve exceptions and correct unsafe handling
Write and check the supervision outcome and unresolved-exception note
Commit the checked supervision note

tasks.design: Configure a native packing-progress and cutoff view in {OPS_SYSTEM}, retaining interpretation and assignment judgement. Write/check actual assignments before a separate queue commit. Keep briefing and physical supervision fully human; separately capture/check the outcome note before its commit. No model evaluates workers or assigns them by inferred traits.
tasks.previous_blocker: A queue status does not establish safe handling or workable staffing.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing warehouse events can be shown together with shipment cutoffs.
tasks.still_hard: Work prioritisation, instruction and floor exceptions remain supervisory work.
tasks.human_edge: Notice an unsafe practice and resolve it with the worker in the actual situation.
tasks.altitude: Less status navigation and approved record posting; unchanged floor supervision.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a native WMS view can consolidate existing scan progress and shipment cutoffs without deciding worker assignments.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for agent labour only. Existing worker labour is not claimed as saved or replaced. Validate actual cross-screen navigation and posting effort; current automation earns no new benefit.

Packers already produce shipment_id, scan_time, quantity and status events under the existing workflow; shipping administration supplies cutoff and priority. No new scans or free exception classification are assumed. s1 retains stale/missing-event investigation; absent reliable events use the existing manual view.

s2/s3 agent captures worker_id, shipment_id, task, handling_instruction and priority; full decision/writing time stays counted. s7 captures observed_issue, outcome and next_owner at full time. Native forms precede code.
a1 binds actual final assignments after s3; a2 binds actual final note after s7. Edits revoke approval. Queue posting sends no separate notification; workers receive the full human briefing in s5.
unknowns: Existing WMS views and event quality
research_questions: Can the current WMS show the same verified progress in one view without asking workers to create new inputs?

incremental.description: Check progress-view mappings and assignment permissions

approvals.approved_version: s3 final assignments and warehouse queue destination
s7 final supervision note and work reference

tasks.short: Resolve shipment problems with vendors, claims departments or repair depots.

steps.what: Verify the shipment problem and collect the relevant documents and damage evidence
Assemble the selected shipment evidence into a source-linked contact package
Prepare the vendor, claims or depot request using verified shipment fields
Approve the complete contact request, evidence disclosure and external recipient
Contact the vendor, claims department or depot with the approved request
Discuss the problem and negotiate a provisional claim resolution or repair arrangement
Write and approve final resolution terms within the agent's actual authority
Send the approved final resolution or repair acceptance to the counterparty
Write and check the actual shipment case outcome record
Commit the checked shipment outcome record
Prepare and approve the concise actual-status update for the customer
Send the approved shipment outcome update to the customer

tasks.design: Configure a native evidence-package export from {OPS_SYSTEM}/{DOCS} and a request template using the agent's selected facts. Keep evidence verification, negotiation and final terms human. Separate the initial contact send, final acceptance send, actual outcome commit and customer update; each uses its own completed-version approval. A repair arrangement is not marked as a completed repair.
tasks.previous_blocker: A document package can support discussion but cannot settle liability or confirm a repair.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exports and exact-field templates can reduce repeated evidence copying and message transfer.
tasks.still_hard: Missing evidence, contested responsibility and workable repair terms require negotiation.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve the actual shipment problem without making an unsupported promise.
tasks.altitude: Less evidence handling, unchanged negotiation and authority checks.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native shipment exports and request templates can support claims or repair correspondence without deciding liability.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for an agent-authorised resolution case. Observe actual manual assembly/copy/send actions first; existing native exports earn no new benefit.

s1 agent collects/checks shipment_id, problem_description, event_date, affected_items, document_refs, photo_refs and contact_id. Original evidence capture, missing-data work and relevance judgement remain full time. s2 packages only those selected existing sources; it invents no damage code or valuation.

s3 retains the request's substantive writing and exceptions. Native templates are tried first. a1 binds the actual final initial package and recipient after s4; no model admits liability or chooses a depot.

s6 negotiation is provisional. s7 writes/checks exact scope, cost, responsibility, date and acceptance wording within existing authority; a2 binds that completed acceptance. Above-authority terms require the actual human escalation and no automatic acceptance occurs.

Counterparty provides final status/reference; s9 agent captures accepted_terms, actual_status, source_confirmation and next_action at full time before a3. s11 separately writes/checks the final customer wording before a4. Changes revoke affected approvals; pending repair/payment stays pending.
research_questions: Which repeated evidence and message-transfer operations remain after the current shipment system's native templates?

incremental.description: Maintain evidence/export fields and recipient/status mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 final initial request, evidence scope and recipient
s7 final resolution/repair acceptance terms and counterparty
s11 final customer update and recipient

steps.what: Count packing materials and inspect their usable condition on the shelf
outputs: observed packing supply counts and condition

steps.what: Enter and approve the complete stock count and applicable replenishment policy
inputs: observed packing supply counts and condition
outputs: approved packing stock count and policy reference

steps.what: Commit the approved packing material stock count
inputs: approved packing stock count and policy reference

steps.what: Calculate replenishment quantities and populate a draft purchase order
inputs: approved packing stock count and policy reference

steps.what: Review and approve the final packing material order and supplier
Send the approved final order to the supplier
Receive, inspect and put away the delivered packing supplies
Write the actual receipt quantities and delivery discrepancies
Check and approve the final actual receipt record
Commit the approved actual packing supply receipt

tasks.design: Use native inventory and procurement controls in {OPS_SYSTEM}/{PROCUREMENT}: calculate a draft from checked counts, existing approved reorder policy and approved supplier packs. Keep counting, data entry, final order review, receiving and receipt writing explicit. Count posting, supplier order and actual receipt posting are separate gated actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Replenishment cannot safely use assumed shelf counts or undocumented minimum stocks.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reorder arithmetic and approved purchase forms can remove repeated calculation and posting.
tasks.still_hard: Condition checks, changing demand and delivery discrepancies require actual observation.
tasks.human_edge: Notice unusable supplies and judge whether the proposed order meets the next shipment needs.
tasks.altitude: Less reorder arithmetic; full physical stock and receipt checks.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: inventory and procurement systems can calculate quantities from approved reorder settings and route a reviewed order.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, not measured. Check actual current counting, order and posting actions; an existing automatic calculation earns no new saving.

Agent creates SKU, location, usable_quantity, count_time and unit in s1/s2 at full time. Manager is the producer of existing authorised reorder_point and target_stock; supplier catalogue supplies pack_size, price and availability. s2 checks the policy reference; no policy is invented. If absent or stale, s5 calculates/reviews manually and no s4 saving applies.

s5 final order contains supplier, SKU, quantity, unit price, total and delivery terms within the agents existing purchasing authority. a2 binds that complete version; changed price/quantity requires a new approval.

Actual receipt is produced by physical inspection s7, then written s8 and checked s9, never prefilled as delivered from an order. a1 and a3 bind final count/receipt versions. Native controls precede custom code; no payment authority is added.
unknowns: Existing reorder policy and catalogue quality
research_questions: Which manual reorder and posting actions remain after the current inventory systems native controls?

incremental.description: Review reorder settings and approved supplier mapping

approvals.approved_version: s2 final stock count and location
s5 final priced purchase order and supplier

tasks.short: Direct or perform cargo loading and check completeness and weight distribution.

steps.what: Review the cargo plan and determine safe placement under vehicle constraints
Direct or participate in actual cargo loading and positioning
Inspect actual loaded units, positions and available weight measurements
inputs: actual unit labels and weighing records

steps.what: Capture actual cargo identities, quantities, positions and verified weights
Compare actual units with the manifest and calculate recorded weight totals
outputs: cargo identity differences and recorded weight totals

steps.what: Resolve discrepancies and verify completeness and safe actual weight distribution
inputs: cargo identity differences and recorded weight totals
outputs: verified actual cargo completeness and placement conclusion

steps.what: Write and approve the final actual loading record and outstanding issues
inputs: verified actual cargo completeness and placement conclusion

steps.what: Commit the approved actual loading record

tasks.design: Configure native manifest identity/count comparisons and arithmetic in {OPS_SYSTEM} from the agents separately captured actual loading facts. Keep placement decisions, physical direction/participation, inspection and final completeness/balance judgement fully human. Write and check the resulting record before its separate commit. Arithmetic cannot certify physical balance or release a vehicle.
tasks.previous_blocker: A planned manifest does not show what was actually loaded or where it sits.
tasks.enabler_now: Native shipment checks can compare explicitly captured actual units with the manifest.
tasks.still_hard: Physical placement, unstable cargo and actual weight distribution require observation and judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Stop loading and reposition cargo when the real load differs from the safe plan.
tasks.altitude: Small comparison and record-posting savings within predominantly physical loading work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a transport system can compare unit identifiers and quantities and total recorded weights without assessing physical load safety.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Establish actual current manual comparison/posting work; existing native checks earn no new benefit. No loading crew hours or physical vigilance are claimed as saved.

Shipping administration supplies the existing approved manifest and vehicle record. s3/s4 agent inspects/captures shipment_id, unit_id, actual_quantity, actual_position, measured_weight and weight_source at full time. Existing weighing records identify their actual measurement producer; missing weights or ambiguous units require manual investigation in retained steps, never model estimates.

s5 only matches explicit identifiers/counts and totals verified numeric weights against stated limits. s6 retains the actual placement and even-distribution decision, including rechecking after repositioning; no rule-generated safety certificate.

s7 records actual completion, exceptions and unresolved issues before a1 binds that completed version. Changed load facts require revised review. No external dispatch notification or vehicle release is silently performed. Native screens/checks precede code.
unknowns: Available verified weights and position records
research_questions: Does the current transport system already compare the agent-captured actual load with the manifest?

incremental.description: Check identifier mappings and comparison limits
